_comment: Transcribed card text. The Riftscribe API does not publish rules or flavor text — a card record carries only id, public_code, name, set_id, collector_number, variant, rarity, faction, domains, type, orientation, stats, and image URLs. Everything in this file was read off the card art by eye. Energy symbols inside rules text are written as {3} and rendered as a pill.
name: Fizz, Trickster
subtitle: Trickster
rules_text: When you play me, you may play a spell from your trash with Energy cost no more than {3}, ignoring its Energy cost. Recycle that spell after you play it.
reminder_text: You must still pay its Power cost.
